The Problem
Robots navigating dynamic environments need to answer spatial-temporal queries about what they observe—"where was the red bag?"—but current mapping systems either store raw sensor data without semantic meaning or run offline with heavy compute. Most video world models require action labels paired with video frames, which limits them to game or robotics data. DeepMind's Genie architecture removes that constraint by inferring latent actions between frames using no prior action data.
